answer: A reputation bond tied to one hardware-backed identity stops fake agents. First, each agent locks a $200 bond and binds one TPM key from one real device. Second, the bond vests over 90 days while reputation grows only from verified work. Third, clones get slashed: bond lost, key revoked, reputation reset to zero. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 devices, $2,000,000 in bonds plus $1,500,000 in hardware, and 90 days waiting, all lost on first detection. An agent can wander a nebula of strangers and still find a haven, because trust is earned once and cannot be copied like a file.
